text: dsh-voice-ptt 是面向 DSH Web 的按住说话听写插件。在会话输入框左侧显示录音状态和按键提示；按住 F2（也可选择 F4、Insert、右 Ctrl 或右 Shift）开始录音，松开后使用已启用的语音识别服务转写，并把文字插入当前草稿。它支持取消录音、识别就绪提示和中英界面文案，适合希望通过语音向 DSH 输入文本的 Web 用户。使用前需启用 DSH 实验语音输入 bundle、准备识别模型并允许浏览器使用麦克风。

dsh-voice-ptt adds push-to-talk dictation to the DSH Web composer. Hold a chosen key to record; release to transcribe through the enabled speech service and insert text into the current draft. It requires the DSH voice-input bundle, a prepared model, and browser microphone access.
想在 DSH 输入框里按住一个键说话，松开后自动把识别文字放进草稿。
有没有能把语音转成文字并填入 DSH 当前会话的输入工具？
让 DSH Web 支持按住 F2 录音、松开后完成听写。
我不想逐字打提示词，想直接对着麦克风说完再检查草稿。
DSH 能不能用可更换的单键快捷方式进行语音输入？
需要一个语音转文字功能，结果先进入输入框而不要直接发送。
I want to dictate into the DSH composer by holding a key and releasing to insert the transcript.
Can I use push-to-talk speech recognition to fill my current DSH draft?
dsh-voice-ptt 的功能「按住说话录音」：在 DSH Web 会话输入框聚焦时，按住所选按键开始采集麦克风音频，松开结束录音。
dsh-voice-ptt 的功能「松开后转写」：释放按键后将录音转换为 16 kHz 单声道 WAV，并交给 DSH speech Remote 转写；识别结果插入草稿光标位置。
dsh-voice-ptt 的功能「选择按住键」：点击输入框旁的按键提示可展开 F2、F4、Insert、右 Ctrl 和右 Shift 选项；选择后立即生效并保存到 localStorage。
dsh-voice-ptt 的功能「取消录音」：录音期间按其他键、离开页面或切换标签会取消当前录音；识别文本不会发送，而是留在草稿供用户检查。
dsh-voice-ptt 使用 DSH 的 speech Remote；需启用 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle 并准备识别模型，否则按键听写不可用。
dsh-voice-ptt 仅接入 DSH Web 客户端的输入框槽位；当前实现依赖浏览器键盘事件、MediaRecorder 和麦克风权限。

dsh-voice-ptt README · dsh-voice-ptt：English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Push-to-talk dictation for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): **hold a single key in the composer, speak, release** — the transcript is inserted into your draft.

No chord to memorise. Hold **F2**, release, done.

---

dsh-voice-ptt README · What it does：1. Put the cursor in the composer. While it is focused and the draft is empty, a faint hint appears in the toolbar: `Hold F2 to dictate`.
2. **Hold F2** — recording starts and the hint becomes `Recording — release F2 to finish`.
3. **Release** — the audio is transcribed and the text lands at the caret in your draft.

While dictating:

dsh-voice-ptt README · What it does：- Press `Esc`, or press any other key (say, the letter you meant to type), to cancel and discard the recording.
- Losing window focus, or switching the tab away, cancels the recording rather than capturing unrelated audio.
- Exceeding the recognizer's limit stops the recording automatically and transcribes what it got.

dsh-voice-ptt README · Changing the key：The hint **is a button**. Click it to expand the candidate keys, click one, and it applies immediately and is remembered (in `localStorage`).

| Key | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| **F2** (default) | Function key: types no character, minimal conflicts |
| F4 | Function key, further right |
| Insert | Right hand on full-size keyboards; absent on many laptops |
| Right Ctrl | Comfortable for the right pinky |
| Right Shift | Right pinky; on Windows, five taps can trigger Sticky Keys |

dsh-voice-ptt README · Changing the key：Modifier keys work properly: the plugin knows the hold key *is* a modifier, so it does not mistake it for a chord and pass the event through.

The hint, the status line, and these key names follow your DSH language (`en` / `zh`).

To offer a different key, edit `KEY_OPTIONS` at the top of `lib/client.js` (a `{code, labelKey}` array, `code` spelled as `KeyboardEvent.code`, `labelKey` naming an entry in the zh / en dictionaries at the top of the same file).

dsh-voice-ptt README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-ptt
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the command appends it to the profile's bundle stack and mounts it — no hand-editing of `cordis.patch.yml`. From a Git checkout, pin the revision:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:eicon-xyz/dsh-voice-ptt#<commit>'
```

dsh-voice-ptt README · Install：Requires the speech recognizer. Install and enable `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle` and prepare a model once (roughly 230 MB). If the recognizer is not ready, holding the key reports a visible reason in the status line instead of failing silently.

dsh-voice-ptt README · Why a single key needs its own keyboard handling：The official shortcut service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-shortcuts`) dispatches **`keydown` only** — there is no `keyup` event to end a hold. It also rejects modifier-free bindings (`bindingIssue` returns `modifier-required`) and, on the web, restricts chords to a platform allow-list.
section: Why a single key needs its own keyboard handling

text: dsh-voice-ptt README · Why a single key needs its own keyboard handling：So "hold one key and talk" cannot be expressed as a shortcut command. This plugin owns the keyboard instead: document-level `keydown` starts, `keyup` finishes. The trade-off is that it cannot appear in **Settings → Shortcuts**, which is why the key picker lives in the composer.
section: Why a single key needs its own keyboard handling

text:
dsh-voice-ptt README · Keeping a single key from becoming a second modifier：| Situation | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Focus is not in a composer | Does not start recording |
| Any other key pressed while recording | Cancels the take; that key works normally (hold Right Ctrl, press A → `Ctrl+A` still applies) |
| A dialog or menu is open | Yields the key |
| Modified press (`Ctrl+F2`, `Alt+F2`, …) | Not intercepted at all |
| Focus is in a terminal | Not intercepted (xterm needs function keys) |
section: Keeping a single key from becoming a second modifier

text:
dsh-voice-ptt README · How it works：- **Draft insertion** uses the session-scoped `inputActions` (`captureInsertion` + `insertText`). The plugin registers a resident entry in `conversation.input.left` to record each session's actions; that same entry renders the status line, the focus hint, and the key picker.
- **Recording** uses `MediaRecorder` and resamples through `OfflineAudioContext` to 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV — the same format the official voice-input plugin sends — then calls the host's `speech.transcribe`.
- **The host half is deliberately empty.** Every behaviour lives in the browser half, reached through `dsh.client`.

dsh-voice-ptt README · Files：| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: keys, recording, transcription, status line, key picker |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half (intentionally empty, so the bundle row is mountable) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | `dsh.bundle.patch` layer the installer merges |
| `test/` | Headless-Chrome end-to-end tests |

dsh-voice-ptt README · Tests：They drive a real browser against a running DSH web profile, with Chrome's fake microphone fed the bundled fixture:

```sh
npm install                       # provides ws
export PTT_TOKEN=<token from the dsh web URL>
node test/e2e.cjs                 # hold → release → transcript inserted
node test/picker.cjs              # picker opens, a new key applies and persists

`test/make-fixture.cjs` regenerates `test/fixtures/speech-16k.wav` from any audio Chrome can decode:

dsh-voice-ptt README · Tests：```sh
node test/make-fixture.cjs input.mp3        # needs Chrome; no ffmpeg required
```

dsh-voice-ptt README · Limitations：- Web surface only (the desktop native keyboard bridge is not wired to this plugin).
- No streaming captions: the text appears after you release.
- Never sends automatically — the transcript goes to the draft for you to review.
- One hold key at a time, and only from the built-in candidate list unless you edit `KEY_OPTIONS`.

dsh-voice-ptt README · dsh-voice-ptt：[English](README.md) | 中文

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的按住听写（push-to-talk）：**在输入框里按住一个键说话，松开即转写**，文字插入当前草稿。

不用记组合键。按住 **F2**，松开，完事。

---

dsh-voice-ptt README · 怎么用：1. 把光标放进输入框。当输入框获得焦点且草稿为空时，工具栏会出现一行淡提示：`按住 F2 听写`。
2. **按住 F2** —— 开始录音，提示变成 `正在录音，松开 F2 结束`。
3. **松开** —— 音频被转写，文字落在草稿的光标处。

听写过程中：

- 按 `Esc`，或按**任何别的键**（比如你本来想打的那个字母），立即取消并丢弃本次录音。
- 窗口失焦、或切走标签页，会取消录音，而不是录下无关的声音。
- 超过识别服务上限会自动停止录音，并转写已经录到的部分。

dsh-voice-ptt README · 换键：那行提示**本身就是按钮**。点它展开候选键，点一个即生效并记住（存在 `localStorage`）。

| 键 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **F2**（默认） | 功能键：不产生字符，冲突最少 |
| F4 | 功能键，位置更靠右 |
| Insert | 全尺寸键盘上右手好按；很多笔记本没有这个键 |
| 右 Ctrl | 右手小指按住最顺手 |
| 右 Shift | 右手小指；在 Windows 上连按 5 次可能触发粘滞键 |

修饰键也能正常工作：插件知道按住键**本身就是修饰键**，因此不会把它误判成组合键而放行事件。

提示文字、状态条和上面这些键名都会跟随 DSH 的界面语言（`en` / `zh`）。

想提供别的键，改 `lib/client.js` 顶部的 `KEY_OPTIONS`（一个 `{code, labelKey}` 数组，`code` 按 `KeyboardEvent.code` 的拼写，`labelKey` 指向 `lib/client.js` 顶部 zh / en 词典里的键名）。

dsh-voice-ptt README · 为什么单键要自己接管键盘：官方快捷键服务（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-shortcuts`）**只派发 `keydown`** —— 没有 `keyup` 事件可以用来结束"按住"。它还拒绝不带修饰键的绑定（`bindingIssue` 返回 `modifier-required`），并且在 Web 端把组合限制在一份平台白名单内。

所以"按住一个键说话"无法表达成快捷键命令。本插件改为自己接管键盘：文档级 `keydown` 开始，`keyup` 结束。代价是它无法出现在**设置 → 快捷键**里 —— 这也是换键入口做在输入框里的原因。
section: 为什么单键要自己接管键盘

text:
dsh-voice-ptt README · 不让单键变成"第二个修饰键"：| 情况 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 焦点不在输入框里 | 不开始录音 |
| 录音期间按了任何别的键 | 取消本次采集；那个键照常工作（按住右 Ctrl 再按 A，`Ctrl+A` 依然生效） |
| 弹窗或菜单打开时 | 让出按键 |
| 带修饰键的按下（`Ctrl+F2`、`Alt+F2` 等） | 完全不拦截 |
| 焦点在终端里 | 不拦截（xterm 自己要用功能键） |
section: 不让单键变成"第二个修饰键"

text:
dsh-voice-ptt README · 实现要点：- **插入草稿**用会话作用域的 `inputActions`（`captureInsertion` + `insertText`）。插件在 `conversation.input.left` 注册一个常驻条目来登记每个会话的动作；同一个条目同时渲染状态条、焦点提示和键位选择器。
- **录音**用 `MediaRecorder`，经 `OfflineAudioContext` 重采样成 16 kHz 单声道 PCM16 WAV —— 与官方语音输入插件发送的格式一致 —— 然后调用 host 的 `speech.transcribe`。
- **host 半侧是有意为空的。** 所有行为都在浏览器半侧，通过 `dsh.client` 触达。

dsh-voice-ptt README · 文件：| 路径 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半侧：按键、录音、转写、状态条、键位选择器 |
| `lib/index.js` | host 半侧（有意为空，只为让 bundle 行可挂载） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 安装器合并的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 层 |
| `test/` | 无头 Chrome 端到端测试 |

dsh-voice-ptt README · 测试：它们驱动真实浏览器、连接一个正在运行的 DSH web profile，并把自带的音频夹具喂给 Chrome 的假麦克风：

```sh
npm install                       # 提供 ws
export PTT_TOKEN=<dsh web URL 里的 token>
node test/e2e.cjs                 # 按住 → 松开 → 文字插入草稿
node test/picker.cjs              # 选择器打开、新键生效并持久化

`test/make-fixture.cjs` 可以从任何 Chrome 能解码的音频重新生成 `test/fixtures/speech-16k.wav`：

```sh
node test/make-fixture.cjs input.mp3        # 需要 Chrome；不需要 ffmpeg
```

dsh-voice-ptt README · 已知限制：- 只在 Web 端生效（Desktop 原生键盘桥接未接线到本插件）。
- 没有流式字幕：松开后才出文字。
- 从不自动发送 —— 转写结果只进草稿，由你确认。
- 同一时刻只监听一个按住键；不改 `KEY_OPTIONS` 的话只能从内置候选键里选。
